mcat_name_audit.reason: The name 'Modular Toilet' directly matches the top primary keyword and is the dominant search and procurement term used by B2B buyers across construction, municipal, and government segments per Agent 3 alt_names and market_context.

reason: The image shows a valid interior shot of a modular toilet-cum-bathroom unit with Western WC, cistern, health faucet, and shower — correctly representing the product category without wrong-product contamination.

An interior view fails to communicate the prefabricated cabin form factor (exterior shell, portability, structural material) that differentiates this MCAT from a permanent toilet; an exterior shot of the full cabin unit would be significantly more informative for B2B buyers evaluating the product.

mcat_image_suggestions.prompt_for_generation: Exterior view of a standalone prefabricated FRP modular toilet cabin, light grey or off-white colour, single-seater unit, placed on flat ground at a construction site. The cabin shows a closed door with handle, ventilation louvre near the top, and clean panel joints visible. Bright natural daylight, slight three-quarter angle to show two sides of the cabin, plain white or light sky background. Photorealistic product-style render, sharp focus, no people, no text overlays.
